ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT COUNTRY, POPULATION FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRYPOPS WHERE YEAR IN (SELECT YEAR FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRYPOPS ORDER BY YEAR DESC, COUNTRY ASC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY) ORDER BY POPULATION DESC, COUNTRY ASC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

interactions.speaker: User
interactions.utterance: What are the religions of those countries?
interactions.intention: Retrieve the religions of the 5 countries with the largest populations in the previously selected years.

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT R.NAME, R.PERCENTAGE, R.COUNTRY FROM MONDIAL_RELIGION R JOIN MONDIAL_COUNTRYPOPS CP ON R.COUNTRY = CP.COUNTRY WHERE (CP.COUNTRY) IN (SELECT COUNTRY FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRYPOPS WHERE YEAR IN (SELECT YEAR FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRYPOPS ORDER BY YEAR DESC, COUNTRY ASC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY) ORDER BY POPULATION DESC, COUNTRY ASC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY) ORDER BY R.PERCENTAGE DESC, R.NAME ASC, R.COUNTRY ASC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

interactions.speaker: User
interactions.utterance: What are the 5 largest lakes by area and their corresponding rivers?

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT L.NAME AS LAKE_NAME, L.AREA, R.NAME AS RIVER_NAME FROM MONDIAL_LAKE L JOIN MONDIAL_RIVER R ON L.RIVER = R.NAME ORDER BY L.AREA DESC, L.NAME ASC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

interactions.speaker: User
interactions.utterance: What are the 5 highest elevation lakes from those?
interactions.intention: What are the 5 highest elevation lakes among those previously selected?

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT NAME, ELEVATION FROM MONDIAL_LAKE WHERE (NAME, AREA) IN (SELECT L.NAME, L.AREA FROM MONDIAL_LAKE L JOIN MONDIAL_RIVER R ON L.RIVER = R.NAME ORDER BY L.AREA DESC, L.NAME ASC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY) ORDER BY ELEVATION DESC, NAME ASC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

interactions.speaker: User
interactions.utterance: Which types do these lakes belong to?
interactions.intention: What are the types of those previously selected lakes?

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT NAME, TYPE FROM MONDIAL_LAKE WHERE (NAME, AREA) IN (SELECT L.NAME, L.AREA FROM MONDIAL_LAKE L JOIN MONDIAL_RIVER R ON L.RIVER = R.NAME ORDER BY L.AREA DESC, L.NAME ASC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY) ORDER BY TYPE ASC, NAME ASC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT NAME, ELEVATION FROM MONDIAL_AIRPORT ORDER BY ELEVATION DESC, NAME ASC, IATACODE ASC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
